messages.text: Shop drawings for the Section 08 41 13 storefront glazing system at the entry vestibule are ready to submit, but what's shown doesn't match what's built out in the field mockup -- can you confirm which governs? We would like this closed out ahead of the next submittal deadline. We do not expect this to affect the contract sum. This is not holding up any current work. Please respond within five days so we can proceed with fabrication.

Sheet A-201 is the condition to build to for the Section 08 41 13 storefront glazing system at the entry vestibule; we'll reconcile Detail 5/A501 by addendum. We do not expect this to affect the contract sum. This is not holding up any current work.
